sections.heading: 1. Ease the load
lines: ① Keep the wrist straight; use your whole arm.
② Where you can, use power tools or big handles.
③ Squeeze a soft ball: 5 sec × 10, twice a day.
④ Stay within a comfortable range.

sections.heading: 2. Stop if…

caption:
Lulu turns and tightens tools all day, and the pinky side of the wrist twinges with every twist.

That side of the wrist has a small cartilage cushion and tendons that work hard during twisting. Twisting forcefully with the wrist bent towards the pinky can add load. Keep the wrist straight and use your whole arm, choose power tools or bigger handles where you can, and try gentle soft-ball squeezes, 5 seconds × 10, within a comfortable range.

Pain that started after a fall, swelling or painful clicking, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
